External data used for the spam model (public GitHub repositories, no licence file stated - used for research/coursework, cite if reported):

- pjbrav_new_test_430.csv   : same repo, new_test_500.csv - NOT used for training.
- indian_scam_sms_172.csv   : github.com/muzamilaminmir/Indian-Scam-SMS-Detector backend/dataset.csv.
